title: 航班价格观察台
prompt: 这是我收藏的航班最近两周价格，帮我看看波动，换一天出发能省多少？
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, tip])
$dayIndex = 0
$details = false
prices = [1420, 1380, 1350, 1410, 1290, 1240, 1210, 1190, 1260, 1330, 1400, 1470, 1390, 1280]
rows = @Each(@Range(0, 14), "i", {date: @AddDays(@Today(), i), dow: @FormatDate(@AddDays(@Today(), i), "weekday"), price: prices[i]})
minPrice = @Min(rows.price)
maxPrice = @Max(rows.price)
avgPrice = @Avg(rows.price)
selected = rows[$dayIndex]
selectedDate = @FormatDate(selected.date, "date")
selectedDateShort = @FormatDate(selected.date, "weekday")
selectedPrice = selected.price
saving = selectedPrice - minPrice
lowest = @Find(rows, "price", minPrice)
lowestDate = lowest.date
lowestLabel = @FormatDate(lowestDate, "date") + " · " + @FormatDate(lowestDate, "weekday")
flux = @Percent(maxPrice - minPrice, minPrice)
tableRows = @Each(rows, "r", [r.date, r.dow, Price(r.price, "¥", "起")])
intro = Text("你收藏的这班航班最近 14 天价格有起伏。拖动日期轴，看看换到低价日出发能省多少。下方为示例数据，仅用于演示波动，不是实时报价。", "md")
sampleNote = Caption("示例数据 · 最近 14 天，金额可按实际收藏记录替换")
chart = Chart("line", rows, "date", ["price"], "currency", "CNY", false, 190)
slider = Slider($dayIndex, 0, 13, 1, "出发日期（0 = 今天）")
summary = Col([Row([Badge("两周波动 " + @Round(flux) + "%", "warning"), Spacer(), Caption("最高 ¥" + maxPrice)], 2), Row([Caption("所选日期 " + selectedDate + " · " + selectedDateShort), Spacer(), Text("¥" + selectedPrice, "md", null, "semibold")], 2), Row([Caption("最低日 " + lowestLabel), Spacer(), Text("¥" + minPrice, "sm")], 2), Row([Caption("换日可省"), Spacer(), Text(saving > 0 ? "¥" + saving : "已是最低价", "md", saving > 0 ? "danger" : "success", "semibold")], 2)], 1)
detailToggle = Button($details ? "收起每日价格" : "查看每日价格", @Set($details, !$details), "ghost", null, "sm", $details ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down")
detailsTable = Table(["日期", "星期", "价格"], tableRows)
detail = $details ? detailsTable : null
tool = TravelModule([sampleNote, chart, slider, summary, detailToggle, detail], "flight", "航班价格波动", "示例数据 · 最近 14 天（非实时报价）")
tip = Text("波动主要来自临近出发的余票变化。这组示例数据的均价约为 ¥" + @Round(avgPrice) + "，若日期灵活，优先选低于均价的日期出发；但低价可能随时变动，下单前请以实时报价为准。")
